```yaml
name: i18n-check

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  i18n-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      BASE_BRANCH: ${{ github.base_ref || 'main' }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Determine merge base
        id: merge_base
        run: |
          MERGE_BASE=$(git merge-base $BASE_BRANCH $GITHUB_SHA)
          echo "MERGE_BASE=$MERGE_BASE" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "Merge base: $MERGE_BASE"

      - name: Detect base‑only files
        id: base_only
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # Files changed in base branch since merge base
          git diff --name-only $MERGE_BASE $BASE_BRANCH | sort > /tmp/base.txt
          # Files changed in current branch since merge base
          git diff --name-only $MERGE_BASE $GITHUB_SHA | sort > /tmp/ours.txt
          # Base‑only files: in base.txt but not in ours.txt
          BASE_ONLY=$(comm -23 /tmp/base.txt /tmp/ours.txt | tr '\n' ',')
          echo "BASE_ONLY_FILES=$BASE_ONLY" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "Base‑only files: $BASE_ONLY"

      - name: Rebase onto base branch
        id: rebase
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git fetch origin $BASE_BRANCH
          git rebase origin/$BASE_BRANCH
        continue-on-error: false

      - name: Post‑rebase regression scan
        id: regression_scan
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # Verify base‑only files unchanged after rebase
          if [ -n "$BASE_ONLY_FILES" ]; then
            IFS=',' read -ra FILES <<< "$BASE_ONLY_FILES"
            for file in "${FILES[@]}"; do
              [ -z "$file" ] && continue
              diff=$(git diff --name-status $BASE_BRANCH HEAD -- "$file")
              if [ -n "$diff" ]; then
                echo "::error::Regression detected: $file differs from base branch after rebase."
                exit 1
              fi
            done
          fi

          # Detect unintended deletions
          DELETIONS=$(git diff --name-status $BASE_BRANCH HEAD | grep '^D' | cut -f2)
          if [ -n "$DELETIONS" ]; then
            for file in $DELETIONS; do
              if git ls-tree -r --name-only $BASE_BRANCH | grep -Fxq "$file"; then
                echo "::error::Unintended deletion detected: $file was deleted but existed in base branch."
                exit 1
              fi
            done
          fi
          echo "Regression scan passed."

      - name: Commit rebase changes (if any)
        uses: stefanzweifel/git-auto-commit-action@04702edda442b2e678b25b537cec683a1493fcb9
        with:
          commit_message: "Rebase regression scan changes"
          branch: ${{ github.head_ref }}
          commit_options: '--no-verify'
          add_options: '--all'
          status_options: '--untracked-files=no'
          skip_dirty_check: true
```
